Subtract 293 days from 1097-06-15.  
1097 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1097-06-15 back 15 days → 1097-05-31.  
From 1097-05-31 back 278 more days (293 total):  
278 days before May 31:  
April: 30 days → back to May 1 (30 days before May 31)  
March: 31 days → back to April 1 (61 days before May 31)  
February: 28 days (1097 not leap) → back to March 4 (89 days before May 31)  
Remaining 278 − 89 = 189 days earlier than March 4.  
Go into 1096 (leap year? 1096 divisible by 4: yes, leap).  
From 1097-03-04 back 4 days → 1097-02-28.  
Back further: 189 − 4 = 185 days before 1097-02-28.  
In 1096 (leap): Dec 31 is day 366 of year.  
Days from 1097-02-28 to 1096-12-31: Jan (31) + Feb (29 in leap) = 60 days.  
185 − 60 = 125 days before 1096-12-31.  
125 days before Dec 31: count back:  
Dec: 0 (starting Dec 31), Nov 30 → 30, Oct 31 → 61, Sep 30 → 91, Aug 31 → 122.  
125 − 122 = 3 more days back from Aug 31 → Aug 28, 1096.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1096-08-28
